scope: 21 Cause-B tasks whose acceptance needs external measured, physical or independently labelled data. Software harnesses exist; the physical datasets do not.
scientific_admission_policy: Every entry is false. No physical value, label, benchmark or measurement is synthesized, estimated or copied from a planning document. An absent dataset keeps its dependent claim blocked; it does not block unrelated software work.
common_provenance_requirements: Every raw file is recorded with its SHA-256 digest, source identifier, retrieval or measurement date in UTC, and access or licence status.
Every numeric value carries an explicit unit. SI base units are preferred; any other unit is declared with its conversion source.
Every value carries an uncertainty statement with its components, or the word unresolved.
Concentration values declare their basis (mass fraction, volume fraction or mass per volume) and the measurement method.
Physical subjects are identified by the SHA-256 digest of the exact accepted geometry or artifact, not by name or description.
Raw files that cannot enter public Git stay in private storage; only their digests and metadata are referenced here.

status_values.software_harness_verified_awaiting_exter: Harness path exists at the as_of_commit. Its software tests are cited by the packet receipts; no physical dataset is admitted.

required_physical_inputs: Process-qualified material passport: alloy grade, powder lot identifier and product form, each with source record digest.
LPBF parameters with units: machine identifier, laser power in W, scan strategy, layer thickness in m.
Build orientation as angle in degrees relative to the build plate, with reference frame.
Heat treatment and HIP schedule: temperature in K or degrees C with time in s, with furnace calibration record digest.
Per-face finish classes and service temperature in degrees C with environment description.
Defect assumptions: porosity stated as volume fraction or area fraction with measurement method.
Each allowable: value with unit, test standard identifier, specimen count, uncertainty and source document SHA-256. Unresolved allowables stay status unresolved.
Build-volume envelope of the named machine in mm, with machine calibration record digest.
Measured minimum wall and feature dimensions on the coupon set in mm, with CT or caliper method and uncertainty.
Overhang angle in degrees and support accessibility records for each internal downskin face.
Powder-removal channel minimum cross-section in mm, measured on a physical or CT reference.
Tool swept-volume access geometry as STEP or STL, with declared unit and SHA-256 of the file.
Process-threshold sheet digest and the passport identifier it applies to. Thresholds are not copied from source constants.
Per-face areal roughness parameters Sa and Sz in micrometres, with instrument identifier, instrument calibration certificate digest, sampling area in mm2 and filter cutoff in mm.
Face orientation in degrees relative to the build direction for each measured face.
Finish class label per face, with the measurement that assigned it.
Variant identity: SHA-256 digest binding the orientation set and the finish-class set to one physical subject.
Coupon plan records for tensile, fatigue, density, porosity, roughness and CT calibration, each with specimen identifier, build position and passport identifier.
Instrument calibration record digest and uncertainty budget components for each measurement type.
CT voxel size in micrometres, scan parameters, and calibration phantom SHA-256 digest.
Accountable external dependency entries: laboratory or vendor name, scope and status. No order is placed and no vendor is contacted by this manifest.
For each candidate source (Bai, Young, Zhou, Hsieh): citation, retrieval date in UTC, licence statement, and SHA-256 digest of the retained file, which stays private.
Geometry as dimensioned drawing values in mm with reference frame and SHA-256 of the geometry used.
Fluid properties with units: density in kg/m3, dynamic viscosity in Pa s, and oil and water identity.
Boundary conditions with units: absolute pressure in Pa, flow rate in m3/s, and wall treatment description.
Measurement station coordinates in mm and the measurement method for each station.
Uncertainty statement with units for each observable. Unresolved inputs are listed as unresolved, never filled.
Tangential and axial velocity profiles in m/s, sampled at radial coordinates in mm, with station identifier and measurement uncertainty per point.
Reverse-core indicator with extent in mm and the criterion used to define it.
Pressure drop in Pa and split as mass fraction or volume fraction, with the basis declared.
Grade observation with declared size basis and unit, only where a corresponding measurement exists.
Mechanism and regime descriptor for each observable, with the source that assigned it.
Measured or reference Reynolds-stress covariance components in m2/s2 at declared stations and times.
LES resolved and modelled energy fractions, each with unit and derivation.
Inlet turbulence intensity with declared basis (dimensionless or percent) and its measurement method.
Realizability repair record: the applied change, its magnitude in the same unit, and the component affected.
Inlet sensitivity dataset with SHA-256 digest.
Droplet or particle size distribution at declared stations in micrometres, with number or volume basis declared.
Exposure history: shear rate in s-1 and residence time in s, per station.
Daughter mass closure record with its tolerance and unit.
Measured breakup-rate data with uncertainty, and the calibration status of the breakup model (valid or invalid, with reason).
Diagnostic Hinze diameter reported separately; it is not a calibration input.
Printed mass upper bound in kg with the weighing or CT method and its uncertainty.
Structural reserve lower bound under common demand, as a dimensionless reserve with its load case reference in Pa.
Compliant treated capacity lower bound in m3/h with duty definition and metering record.
Common-duty energy upper bound in kWh with metering record digest.
Owner-frozen objective weight profile record. The weight profile is not accepted until frozen; no default profile is admitted by this manifest.
Accepted wall-pressure spectra: power spectral density in Pa2/Hz on a frequency axis in Hz, with measurement location coordinates in mm, sampling rate in Hz and window description.
Fluid added-mass measurement or validated estimate in kg with method and uncertainty.
As-built modal test frequency response data in Hz with damping ratio (dimensionless) on the actual supports.
Support stiffness in N/m for each support, with measurement method.
S-N test data: stress amplitude in Pa, cycles to failure as a count, stress ratio R (dimensionless) and mean stress in Pa.
Process, orientation, finish and defect tags on every curve, each referencing its passport identifier.
Run-out target declared as a cycle count, with the specimen survival record.
Measured cycle-count spectrum from loads, binned by amplitude in Pa with counts per bin.
Test standard identifier and SHA-256 digest of each test record.
CT calibration phantom records and scan parameters: voxel size in micrometres, tube voltage in kV, filter identifier.
Registration fiducial coordinates in mm and the registration residual in mm.
Feature detectability threshold record with the test feature size in mm.
Surface and roughness measurements per face (see V5-13-04 units).
As-built geometry file SHA-256 with declared unit, and the nominal-to-as-built deviation field in mm.
Nominal and as-built identities recorded as separate digests.
Deterministic manufacturing tolerance bands per dimension in mm, kept distinct from any probabilistic distribution.
Load envelope bounds in N or Pa with source test or load record digest.
Material property bounds taken from the passport with declared units (Pa, kg/m3).
Declared distribution type for any probabilistic input, with the source of its parameters. Probabilistic inputs are not used to report reliability percentiles.
Second-route solver or reference results: modal frequencies in Hz and displacement or strain observables with units, plus the mesh identity SHA-256.
Measured load-case strain or pressure references in microstrain or Pa, with gauge or transducer calibration certificate digest.
Nonlinear stability reference measurement with its test conditions.
Discrepancy statement between routes with units, kept as an uncertainty contribution.
Admitted independent-label records: subject identifier as SHA-256 of the accepted artifact, observation value with SI unit and uncertainty.
Labeller identity and qualification status, recorded per label.
Lineage or family identifier for grouped train and held-out splits.
Reason code for every missing, invalid or out-of-scope label.
EV-09 readiness and EV-12 disposition references carried with each dataset version.
Cut-plane state values with units: radial and azimuthal velocity in m/s, turbulence quantity in m2/s2, reverse-core radius in mm.
Size-dependent oil mass flux in kg/s at declared cut-plane coordinates in mm.
Boundary pressure in Pa at the admitted cut plane, with its measurement or derivation record.
Conservation balance closure tolerances declared with units before the check is run.
Uncertainty component per state variable.
Full-liner accepted geometry SHA-256 digest, with the geometry unit declared.
Flow rate in m3/h, pressure in Pa, concentration in mg/L or mass fraction with declared basis, and drop size distribution in micrometres on a number basis.
Station coordinates in mm for every measurement.
Family and lease identifiers that separate training and held-out cases.
Raw DAQ file SHA-256 digests, sampling rate in Hz, and sensor calibration certificate digests.
Claim-binding labels: each paper claim mapped to an observation identifier, subject SHA-256, scenario, estimand, unit with declared SI basis, evidence tier and allowed interpretation.
Independent human reviewer identity and review record for each binding.
Reference to the immutable historical paper digest and any correction record.
No numeric value is entered from memory or from a planning document; every value is taken from a referenced manifest.
Bolt and support interface dimensions in mm, with drawing digest.
Bolt preload in N with bolt grade and source document digest.
Admitted fixture load cases in N and N m, each with source digest.
Bracket material properties in Pa and kg/m3, referencing a material passport identifier.
Geometric bounds in mm, with the source of each bound.
Review record confirming that no hydrocyclone constant is used by the bracket pack.
Synchronized DAQ records with timestamps in UTC: inlet and outlet concentration with declared basis, drop size distribution in micrometres.
Every flow stream in m3/h and every pressure in Pa, each with sensor serial number and calibration certificate SHA-256.
Temperature in degrees C or K, and tank inventory in kg or L.
Sample-line and sensor lag in s, measured by a step or tracer test with its digest.
Censored and delayed record flags, with the recovery-control logs that test them.
Specimen process record and passport identifier for each independently built specimen.
Coupon data: tensile, fatigue, density and porosity records with units and SHA-256 digests.
CT, roughness and orifice measurement records in mm or micrometres, with calibration digests.
Proof and tap test results in Pa and s, with the test record digest.
As-built subject SHA-256 (STL or STEP) with declared unit.
Re-evaluation record for each specimen whose physical geometry changed from the nominal.
